_comment: Evaluator-only settings, passed by run.sh via --settings on every /evaluate invocation. This mechanically enforces evaluator-system.md's boundary instead of trusting a prompt: the evaluator may write ONLY under features/ (its verdict JSON and the feature file's status frontmatter) and cannot stage, commit, checkout, or otherwise mutate the branch. It runs WITHOUT --permission-mode acceptEdits, so in headless (-p) mode any Edit/Write outside features/ is auto-denied. Settings merge with .claude/settings.json and DENY BEATS ALLOW, so the git write commands the generator needs are explicitly re-denied here. The read/search tools (Read, Grep, Glob, and Bash grep/rg/find/ls) are allowed HERE rather than relied upon from .claude/settings.local.json, because the headless harness run does not load the personal local settings file — without these the evaluator cannot search the codebase and burns its whole turn budget thrashing on denied Grep calls. cat is intentionally NOT allowed (it would defeat the .env read-deny), and the .env/secrets Read denies are re-stated here so the added search tools can't be turned into a secret read. The hooks below add the EVIDENCE GATE: track-evidence.sh logs execution events (Playwright calls, test/app runs, curl probes, screenshot reads) and verify-gate.sh denies writing the verdict file until enough of them exist — a zero-execution verdict is mechanically impossible, not just prompted against. The driver resets the evidence log before each evaluation. The **/features/** allow variants exist because on Windows the CLI matches the tool's absolute path against these rules and the bare relative form never matches — without them the evaluator cannot write its own verdict file.
